verdict.rationale: A tax agency could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec for e-filing or software developers, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no OpenAPI or equivalent spec: probes of all common OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404, and the taxpayer portal is an authenticated interactive shell. The only schema mention is a 1099 XML file format that follows IRS schemas hosted on the IRS IRIS site. That is an adjacent upload format owned by another agency, not a downloadable API spec from this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
